_comment: Links each knowledge-base folder to a Google Drive folder, for the qa-kb-sync skill.
Paste a Drive FOLDER link per folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/<id>).
Leave a folder as <PASTE...> to skip it. These links are the same for the whole
project team, so commit this file once and teammates get them when they clone.
The documents themselves are downloaded locally and are NEVER committed to git.
